_dependency_manifest: @dependency-start
responsibility Configures Codex hook entrypoints for repo guardrails.
upstream implementation config.toml enables project-local Codex hooks
upstream design README.md documents hook wiring and optional MCP checks
downstream implementation hooks/hook_dispatcher.py dispatches lifecycle events to guard scripts
downstream implementation hooks/log_archive_mount_warning.py warns when the shared log archive is not mounted
downstream implementation hooks/prompt_secret_guard.py blocks obvious prompt secrets
downstream implementation hooks/skill_usage_logger.py logs observed skill, workflow, tool, and subagent routing usage
downstream implementation hooks/reference_capture_guard.py logs unregistered external source URLs as warning evidence
downstream implementation hooks/cause_investigation_guard.py warns on code edits before cause investigation evidence
downstream implementation hooks/goal_completion_guard.py warns on premature goal completion
downstream implementation hooks/task_authority_schema_guard.py validates request-local task authority
downstream implementation hooks/role_write_policy_guard.py enforces active role write policies
downstream implementation hooks/oop_readability_guard.py warns on current changed-source OOP readability failures
downstream implementation hooks/module_boundary_guard.py warns on forced module-internal rewrites without boundary evidence
downstream implementation hooks/library_implementation_guard.py warns on direct vendored library implementation rewrites
downstream implementation hooks/first_party_library_guard.py warns on first-party reusable API changes without task authority
downstream implementation hooks/helper_inventory_guard.py warns on repo-policy helper inventory findings
downstream implementation hooks/helper_first_guard.py warns on helper-function-first implementation drift
downstream implementation hooks/style_checker_guard.py runs changed-file style checks and logs unchecked edits
downstream implementation hooks/log_surface_inventory_guard.py warns on hook/tool/skill log-surface inventory drift
downstream implementation hooks/notebook_quality_guard.py warns on changed notebooks that behave like tests
downstream implementation hooks/codex_runtime_summary_logger.py exports bounded Codex runtime summaries
downstream implementation hooks/runtime_log_auto_sync.py syncs runtime logs and agent reports to the archive
downstream implementation ../tests/agent_tools/test_codex_hooks.py validates hook wiring
@dependency-end
